title: ALLSEER Audit Record
description: One line of the audit log. Every line carries a 'record' field naming its kind, and a reader dispatches on it. Decisions are the per-event verdicts; the other kinds are session-level facts that frame them: what the probes could see when the session started, how approval requests were answered, control requests refused, and how the session ended.

sessionStart.description: Written when an agent begins running under governance. Carries what every later decision in the session is judged against. Sessions do not survive a daemon restart, so the envelope here is the only durable copy.

coverage.description: What the attached probes could observe. A missing record for an operation the probes could not see is not evidence that the operation did not happen.

unobservable.description: What this build can watch and this load could not.

degraded.description: This load lost something this build can watch.

entry_points.description: Observable kinds that some entry point is not watched for, whether the build never watches it or this load lost it.

missing.description: Entry points that produce no record at all.

success_only.description: Entry points recorded only when the kernel permitted the operation.

approval.description: The answer to an approval request a frozen session was waiting on: a human's, or the configured default when nobody answered in time.

effect.description: resume: the last open request was approved and the session resumes. wait: approved, but other requests keep it frozen. terminate: denied or timed out under deny; the session is killed and its other requests withdrawn. none: approved, but an earlier denial is already terminating the session.

controlRefused.description: A control-socket request the daemon turned down because the caller was inside a governed session, or could not be located.

session_id.description: The session whose cgroup holds the caller, when known.

sessionEnd.description: Written once, when a session reaches a terminal state, whether or not it ever started.

result.description: completed: the agent finished. terminated: policy stopped it. failed: governance itself broke.

telemetry_complete.description: False qualifies every conclusion drawn from the session, including that nothing bad happened.

unmatched_connects.description: Connections policy allowed although no grant matched them. Every mode allows these at low risk, enforce included.

unmatched_connect_targets.description: The most frequent of those, most frequent first.

leftover.description: An action on a session cgroup a previous daemon left behind with processes still in it: frozen by the startup sweep, or thawed or killed by an operator.

session_id.description: The cgroup's name, which is the dead session's ID.

pids.description: The processes in the group when the action was taken.

by.description: The user who acted, or startup for the sweep.
